public void OnUpdate(float elapsed) // event used for procedural draw
{
    if (goku.IsProceduralDrawing())
        goku.ProceduralDraw(); // don't change anything here
}

public void PressMeGoku(TriggerArgs args)
{
    goku.StartProceduralDraw(((IObject)args.Caller).GetWorldPosition()); // a button that will procedural draw goku
}

public void PressMeKrillin(TriggerArgs args)
{
    krillin.Draw(((IObject)args.Caller).GetWorldPosition()); // a button that will immediately draw krillin
}

public void ClearButton(TriggerArgs args) // this button will erase the images
{
    krillin.Clear();
    goku.Clear();
}
*/

public struct Sprite
{
    private string data;
    private bool procedural;
    private List<IObjectText> pixels;
    private int temp, width, height;
    private Vector2 pos;

    public Sprite(string data)
    {
        this.data = data;
        procedural = false;
        temp = 0;
        width = int.Parse(data.Split('|')[0].Split('_')[0]);
        height = int.Parse(data.Split('|')[0].Split('_')[1]);
        pixels = new List<IObjectText>();
        pos = new Vector2();
    }

    private void CreateProceduralScreen()
    {
        for (int y = height; y > 0; y--)
        {
            IObjectText text = (IObjectText)Game.CreateObject("BgText", pos + new Vector2(temp, y));
            text.SetTextScale(1.1f);
            text.SetText(".");
            pixels.Add(text);
        }
        temp++;
    }

    private void CreateScreen()
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < int.Parse(data.Split('|')[0].Split('_')[0]); x++)
        {
            for (int y = int.Parse(data.Split('|')[0].Split('_')[1]); y > 0; y--)
            {
                IObjectText text = (IObjectText)Game.CreateObject("BgText", pos + new Vector2(x, y));
                text.SetTextScale(1.1f);
                text.SetText(".");
                pixels.Add(text);
            }
        }
    }

    public void Draw(Vector2 pos)
    {
        if (pixels.Count == 0)
        {
            if (this.pos != pos)
                this.pos = pos - new Vector2(5.1f, 1.6f);
            CreateScreen();
            AssignColors();
        }
    }

    public void ProceduralDraw()
    {
        if (pixels.Count != width * height - 1)
        {
            if (pixels.Count < width * height)
                CreateProceduralScreen();
            else
            {
                procedural = false;
                temp = 0;
                AssignColors();
            }
        }
        else
            procedural = false;
    }

    public void AssignColors()
    {
        string[] info = data.Split('|')[1].Split('/');
        for (int i = 0; i < pixels.Count; i++)
        {
            if (info[i].Split(',').Length == 3)
                pixels[i].SetTextColor(new Color(byte.Parse(info[i].Split(',')[0]), byte.Parse(info[i].Split(',')[1]), byte.Parse(info[i].Split(',')[2])));
            else
                pixels[i].Remove();
        }
    }

    public void Clear()
    {
        if (!procedural && pixels.Count > 0)
        {
            foreach (IObjectText pixel in pixels)
                pixel.Remove();
            pixels.Clear();
        }
    }

    public void StartProceduralDraw(Vector2 pos)
    {
        if (!procedural && pixels.Count == 0)
        {
            if (this.pos != pos)
                this.pos = pos - new Vector2(5.1f, 1.6f);
            procedural = true;
        }
    }

    public bool IsProceduralDrawing()
    {
        return procedural;
    }
}
